Verbs with preposition. Many verbs hold a preposition, and the pronoun attaches itself to that: ⁧أَتَّصِلُ بِكَ⁩ I'm calling you. ⁧أَبْحَثُ عَنْهُ⁩ I'm looking for him. ⁧سَأَلَ عَنْكِ⁩ He asked for you, ⁧قُلْتُ لَهَا⁩ I told her, ⁧أَحْتَاجُ إِلَيْكُمْ⁩ I need you. ⁧سَمَحَ لِي⁩ "It allowed me to do so," ⁧رَدَّ عَلَيْنَا⁩ He replied to us.
